requirements.title: Assigned Clip Batch Delivery
requirements.definition: Produce the number of edited clips assigned for each discrete trial or production batch.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers batch quantity and delivery of the requested video artifacts; clip quality rules, monthly output, deadlines, compensation, and hand-off logistics remain outside this Requirement.

requirements.title: Monthly Approved Clip Output
requirements.definition: Meet the recurring monthly clip-output target, with only client-approved clips counting toward the quota.
requirements.boundary_note: The recurring approved-output quota can change independently of individual batch sizes and quality dimensions; compensation values and payment-release conditions are excluded.

requirements.title: Clip Source Selection
requirements.definition: Select source material from the permitted long-form video collection when creating short-form clips.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers which source videos may be used, not the quality of the selected moment, the clip's narrative completeness, or its duration.

requirements.title: Clip Hook Quality
requirements.definition: Open each clip with a strong, attention-retaining hook.
requirements.boundary_note: Hook effectiveness is independently selectable and trainable; it is separate from whether the body contains a substantive and complete lesson.

requirements.title: Substantive Clip Moment Selection
requirements.definition: Choose impactful source moments that teach a lesson, tell a meaningful story, or communicate a real point.
requirements.boundary_note: The value of the selected moment can fail while captions or other presentation details succeed; completeness of the selected lesson is tracked separately.

requirements.title: Complete Standalone Clip Narrative
requirements.definition: Ensure each clip presents its full lesson, story, or point from beginning to end and remains understandable as a standalone item.
requirements.boundary_note: Narrative completeness has its own repeated failure and correction trajectory and is distinct from moment impact, duration, B-roll, and typography.

requirements.title: Clip Duration
requirements.definition: Keep clips within the currently required duration range or minimum duration for the applicable clip style.
requirements.boundary_note: Duration is independently measurable and repeatedly changed or failed while other content and presentation behavior remained acceptable.

requirements.title: Hook-Based Clip Variations
requirements.definition: Create multiple clip versions by retaining the body and changing the hook or opening, with limited reuse of each body clip.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a distinct production mechanism rather than merely a stronger-hook attribute because it authorizes multiple deliverables from one body clip.

requirements.title: Clean and Simple Visual Editing
requirements.definition: Use clean professional editing without distracting animations, heavy effects, or flashy transitions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers general visual editing style; caption color, font, shadow, and placement have independent acceptance criteria and trajectories.

requirements.title: Caption Color and Effects
requirements.definition: Apply the currently required caption color treatment and avoid disallowed text effects, outlines, or shadows.
requirements.boundary_note: Color and text-effect rules changed and failed independently of font choice and text placement, warranting a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Brand-Compliant Caption Font
requirements.definition: Use the exact brand-approved font or lettering treatment for clip captions.
requirements.boundary_note: Font selection was evaluated separately from caption color, effects, and placement and can be corrected without changing those behaviors.

requirements.title: Stable Caption Placement
requirements.definition: Keep caption text fixed in the required screen position rather than moving it vertically during the clip.
requirements.boundary_note: Placement produced a distinct late-stage failure after other caption revisions had been completed, showing an independent acceptance criterion.

requirements.title: Contextual B-Roll Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate B-roll naturally where it strengthens the spoken message rather than using unrelated footage or filler.
requirements.boundary_note: B-roll use is an independently editable visual behavior and is not merged with narrative completeness or general clean-editing style.

requirements.title: Background Music Selection and Mix
requirements.definition: Use background music that fits the clip's mood and remains below the speaker's voice.
requirements.boundary_note: Music choice and level can be adjusted independently of source-audio noise removal.

requirements.title: Source Audio Cleanliness
requirements.definition: Remove distracting source-audio noise, including wind noise, from completed clips.
requirements.boundary_note: Noise cleanup received its own requested fix and implementation claim and is independent of background-music selection and level.

requirements.title: Dedicated Instagram Account Setup
requirements.definition: Configure a dedicated official-looking Instagram content account with an appropriate username, profile image, bio, and link to the main account.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers account and profile configuration only; credentials are excluded, and clip-post metadata and scheduling remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Approval-Gated Clip Publishing
requirements.definition: Publish a clip only after it has received the required client approval.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an operational release gate, not a generic QA Requirement; the underlying quality failures remain attached to their specific editing Requirements.

requirements.title: Instagram Post Metadata and Attribution
requirements.definition: Apply the required caption, hashtags, and in-post account attribution to each published clip.
requirements.boundary_note: Post copy and tagging are independently configurable and can change without altering publication cadence or account setup.

requirements.title: Instagram Rollout Cadence
requirements.definition: Schedule approved clips according to the required publication frequency and peak-hours window.
requirements.boundary_note: The one-per-day and peak-hours rules control publication behavior rather than project delivery deadlines, and they can change independently of post metadata.

requirements.title: Publication Record Logging
requirements.definition: Record each published clip's posting date and Instagram Reel link in the designated tracking workspace.
requirements.boundary_note: Logging publication data is an independently requested operational record and is separate from creating the post or tracking its later performance.

requirements.title: Posted Clip Performance Tracking
requirements.definition: Track views, engagement, and performance for clips published through the dedicated account.
requirements.boundary_note: Performance metrics are post-publication data and can evolve independently of the publication record containing only the date and Reel link.

unresolved_candidates.description: The permitted source-video scope is unclear: earlier instructions specify Arden Vale's long-form content, while the later reply says any YouTube video is acceptable.
The new shorter clip styles may modify or create an exception to the existing 70-second minimum, but no concrete replacement duration is supplied.
The required main-account attribution is unresolved because the setup and posting instructions reference different Instagram handles.
